title: Gram-Schmidt orthonormalization
summary: Turn a list of vectors into an orthonormal basis of their span, and skip vectors that depend on the earlier ones.

mutants.no_normalize: Keeps the orthogonal vectors but does not divide them by their length.
mutants.keeps_dependent: Does not skip a vector whose residual is zero, so a dependent vector gives NaN.
mutants.wrong_sign: Adds the projection to the vector instead of subtracting it.
mutants.only_first_projection: Removes the part along the first basis vector only, so later vectors are not orthogonal to each other.
mutants.in_place: Subtracts the projections inside the input rows, so the caller's array changes.
